===Passenger===
In 2025, the airport set a new record for annual passenger throughput for a single-runway airport in China, with 29,193,712 passengers.  The airport handled 3.4 million international passengers in 2025, ranking sixth in the country.<!-- Please use independent sources. The airport and the airline itself are not independent sources. -->
